Name: Prismatic tools -RETEXTURED-
Author: RdiatStorm
Description:
This mod just changes the sprites for the prismatic tools continued mod.

The idea of higher level prismatic tools is great but the original art... not so much.
Now I did a retexture of them 100% by hand following the style I like.

I would add descriptions to the tools aswell but the decompilation of dlls and coding is such a pain that I gave up. If someone can help me I will gladly do it.


[b]INSTALLATION:

[/b]-Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450?tab=description]prismatic tools continued[/url]﻿ mod.

-Drag my file over to the mods folder and click "yes" when asked to replace.
